# voipms_phonebook_entries (Data Source)

Lists phonebook entries (`getPhonebook`).


## Example Usage

```terraform
data "voipms_phonebook_entries" "all" {}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) Phonebook entries on this account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier (`phonebook_entries`).

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `callerid` (String) Caller ID name override.
- `group` (String) Phonebook group id.
- `group_name` (String) Phonebook group name.
- `id` (String) Phonebook entry id.
- `name` (String) Contact name.
- `note` (String) Note.
- `number` (String) Phone number or prefix.
- `speed_dial` (String) Speed-dial code.
